update.title: Made the portfolio timeline richer and easier to navigate
update.summary: Timeline entries now adapt to each project’s importance, support animated previews and expandable icon bundles, and preserve filters and selections in shareable URLs.
update.previewAlt: Historical Portfolio Site timeline with compact update rows and a full media card

blocks.body:
## Give each timeline item the right amount of space

I replaced the timeline’s one-size-fits-all markup with a shared entry renderer used by the timeline, featured work, and standalone cards. Projects can now appear as a full media card, a compact preview, or a small icon-and-title row, while GIF and video previews follow the same media path as static images.

blocks.caption: Shared project data controls presentation depth, while timeline filters and selections remain addressable through the URL.
blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Data[Project data] --> Entry[Shared entry renderer]
  Entry --> Large[Large media card]
  Entry --> Compact[Compact preview]
  Entry --> Small[Small icon row]
  Small --> Bundle[Expandable bundle]
  Timeline[Filters and selection] --> Bundle
  Timeline --> URL[Shareable URL state]
blocks.summary: Shared project data controls presentation depth, while timeline filters and selections remain addressable through the URL.

blocks.body:
## Keep filtering and bundling in sync

Older small entries can now combine into expandable bundles with an icon strip. Bundling is recalculated after filters are applied, so a narrow result returns to a normal entry instead of leaving a misleading group. The chosen tags, connection mode, group, and project are written into the URL, allowing the same timeline view to be reopened directly.

part_of.title: Built a timeline-based portfolio site
part_of.summary: Built a framework-free portfolio that loads project metadata from one JSON file, highlights featured work, and expands timeline entries as they move through the viewport.
